limitations: TOI/CTOI/planet/TCE/EB catalogs are the local snapshots listed in catalog_snapshot; a star absent from them may still have been searched by SPOC, QLP or published work.
The TESS EB catalog snapshot covers sectors 1-26 (FFI based); later eclipsing binaries are not excluded by it.
SPOC TCE files cover the DV runs listed on the MAST bulk page at snapshot time.
Baseline, observed days and point counts are estimates from sector start dates; exact coverage is measured after download.
Contamination uses the TIC contratio field; a missing value is not treated as low contamination but is not excluded either.

selection_rules.object: TIC objType STAR, no non-empty disposition except SPLIT
selection_rules.sectors: search window of 2-3 consecutive SPOC 120 s sectors within one season (see search_window)
selection_rules.search_window: the largest group of sectors with gaps of at most 13 sectors, reduced to the 8 spanning the shortest time (most recent on ties)
